assumptions: Static-only enforcement MECHANISM = option (a) branch-based suppression (not option (b) cache overlay): storage:cache path-routing is unimplemented today — every shard under .harness/comprehension/** is force-tracked by .gitignore — so the minimal correct rule is 'no committed semantic unless provably the single writer (main)'.

Single-writer predicate lives in a new pure module comprehension/policy.ts; committedSemanticAllowed() = isMainPassContext = HARNESS_COMPREHENSION_MAIN_PASS=1 OR GITHUB_REF==refs/heads/main OR resolved branch=='main'. Unknown branch (detached HEAD / no-git) defaults to NOT-main-pass (conservative, conflict-avoiding).

Enforcement wired into ALL THREE committed-semantic write paths, not just the two named in the ADR: comprehend --changed/--all (compileComprehension force-static off main-pass), put_comprehension (attachSemantic returns a NON-error 'deferred' result), AND get_comprehension recompile-on-miss (provider resolved only on the main-pass) — the last was discovered during investigation as a third path that writes committed semantic on a branch.

comprehension.ci seam CONSUMED in `comprehend --check`: off=disable gate, verify=default token-free gate, refresh=verify + provider-backed main-pass regeneration guarded by main-pass policy AND provider availability (degrades to no-op token-free when no provider). #1689's keyed runner plugs into runRefreshMainPass. Default stays 'verify' (token-free) per maintainer-local provider choice.

Regression gate reframe via a --context <pr|main> flag; DEFAULT is 'main' (strict, backward-compatible) so CI must pass --context pr explicitly on the PR step. 'pr' returns [] for present→absent (kills the per-PR false positive); added detectCommittedSemanticOnBranch as an advisory PR-path policy companion (flags disallowed committed-semantic ADDITIONS).

CI: PR step now `--context pr`; NEW post-merge main-guard step (push to main) runs `--check --since HEAD^ --context main` with `git fetch --deepen 1`. Both advisory (continue-on-error) per repo first-landing convention.

E2E faked-LLM semantic tests set HARNESS_COMPREHENSION_MAIN_PASS=1 (semantic generation is now a main-pass operation); added an end-to-end test proving PR-path suppression even with a provider on PATH.
Provider question (§3) is settled maintainer-local by ADR 0116 and the brief — no keyed CI runner added (that is #1689, out of scope).
